## Checklist

- [ ] I have read the [Developer Certificate of Origin](https://developercertificate.org/) and
  signed off my commits as described in the contributor guide.
- [ ] I have reviewed and understand the changes, including any AI-assisted changes, and can explain
  and revise them.
- [ ] I have considered tests, documentation, and the changelog where applicable.
- [ ] I have considered compatibility and any intentional public API snapshot changes where
  applicable.
